first.rationale: I intend to test simplified onboarding because onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, and both archived memories indicate that reducing onboarding friction and signup fields improved early activation and time-to-value. I will verify both records before committing. A small guarded test is appropriate because the experiment slot is limited and the objective is sustainable qualified revenue rather than short-term acquisition volume.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment this week among simple self-serve/SMB accounts, using completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention guardrails. The verified evidence supports meaningful gains in completion, time-to-value, activation, and qualified revenue, while showing that shortened onboarding increases churn in complex-workspace accounts. Exclude complex-workspace accounts and avoid generalizing the result beyond the tested segment.
